title: Saving and editing trips
content: Trips created in Travel OS are saved to your account automatically. Open a trip from the Trips screen to continue later. On the web, use Edit itinerary to change activity times, titles, descriptions, costs, or stops, then save the changes.

title: Expense tracking
content: Open a trip and choose Expenses to see budget, spent, remaining, and category totals. Expenses support food, stay, transport, activities, and misc categories. If the web app is offline, a new expense is queued locally and attempted again when the connection returns.

title: Sharing a trip
content: Use Share on a trip to create a shareable read-only link. Anyone with the link can view the shared itinerary, but shared viewers cannot edit the trip. Travel OS does not provide real-time collaborative editing.

title: Profile preferences
content: Open Profile to update your name, profile photo URL, age, budget preference, food preference, languages, and favourite destinations. Save profile changes using the Save profile action.

title: Maps and place links
content: Trip activity, hotel, and restaurant locations can be opened in Google Maps using their map links. The current map tab is a placeholder until a Google Maps Platform key is configured; live directions, nearby search, and embedded maps are not currently available.

title: Deleting trips
content: Deleting a trip currently soft-deletes it so it disappears from the active trip list. A restore screen and restore endpoint are not yet available in the current MVP.
